MOST EVERYTHING ON THIS WEBSITE WAS GENERATED BY AI AS A TEMPORARY PLACEHOLDER. I'LL BE UPDATING THE SITE WITH ACTUAL CONTENT SOON.

Some interests of mine: information theory, quantitative finance, machine learning and AI, statistical mechanics, probability theory, and Bayesian statistics.

This site is mostly a **blog** — a place to work through ideas ranging from
modern portfolio theory and log-optimal (Kelly) investing to Bayesian inference,
computational physics, and the occasional excursion into whatever I find beautiful, interesting, or useful.

Have a look at the [blog](blog.qmd), read more [about me](about.qmd), or say hello
on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jordan-mckittrick-3b1bb638/).
